blocks.en: Slide 7 lays out Direct and Indirect as columns without pairing the four questions to each. The usual rule: direct if the news is important, urgent or audience prefers it; indirect if it is likely to be a shock. This is Extra (not in slides).
blocks.ms: Slaid 7 menyusun Direct dan Indirect dalam lajur tanpa memadankan empat soalan. Peraturan lazim: terus jika berita penting, segera atau audiens suka; tidak terus jika berita mengejutkan. Ini Extra (bukan dalam slaid).

en: State the bad news at the beginning
Focus on the news, not on individuals
Explain or remind the reader why you are writing
ms: Terangkan atau ingatkan sebab anda menulis

en: Explain why the news is negative
Consider the nature of the news
Assess your relationship with the reader
ms: Tentukan sama ada perlu memohon maaf

en: Deliver the apology from the right person in the organisation
Only apologise if it is sincere
ms: Maaf daripada orang yang betul dalam organisasi

en: Communicate how future mistakes will be avoided

blocks.en: The steps reflect the slides’ headings (buffer, clear statement of the bad news, respectful close). The “provide reasons” step is Extra (not in slides): the textbook places reasons before the bad news.
blocks.ms: Langkah mencerminkan tajuk slaid (buffer, pernyataan berita buruk, penutup hormat). Langkah “beri sebab” ialah Extra (bukan dalam slaid): buku teks letak sebab sebelum berita buruk.

en: Assure readers you understand their needs
Tell what you DID, not what you didn’t do
ms: Nyatakan apa yang anda BUAT, bukan yang tidak dibuat

en: Impact of the message on the recipient
Managing emotions of sender and recipient
Open with a buffer; advance your reasoning; announce the change; close on a positive note
ms: Buka dengan buffer; kemukakan alasan; umumkan perubahan; tutup positif

en: Choose approach by: solicited or unsolicited; internal or external source; your relationship with the sender
ms: Pilih pendekatan mengikut: diminta atau tidak; sumber dalaman atau luaran; hubungan dengan penghantar

en: Focus on the most important relationships and requests; don’t leave a closed matter open-ended; offer alternatives; only offer other assistance if available
ms: Fokus hubungan dan permintaan terpenting; jangan biar perkara tertutup terbuka; tawar alternatif; tawar bantuan lain hanya jika ada

en: Three goals: modify the customer’s expectations; explain how you plan to resolve; repair damage to the relationship
ms: Tiga matlamat: ubah jangkaan pelanggan; terangkan cara menyelesaikan; pulihkan hubungan

en: DO: provide accurate information, consult legal advisers, communicate honestly, emphasise good future relationship. DON’T: use abusive language, allow anger or malice, use negative tone, use accusations
ms: BUAT: maklumat tepat, rujuk penasihat undang-undang, jujur, tekankan hubungan masa depan. JANGAN: bahasa kesat, marah atau berniat jahat, nada negatif, tuduhan

en: Match the approach to the situation
Consider the unique needs of each group
Give each audience time to react
ms: Beri masa setiap audiens bertindak balas

en: List news and social media outlets for disseminating information
ms: Senarai saluran berita dan media sosial

en: Employees: be concise, prepare carefully. Applicants: be direct, use tact and diplomacy (reading of slide 35)
ms: Pekerja: ringkas, bersedia teliti. Pemohon: terus, tegas dan diplomasi (bacaan slaid 35)

en: Three options: ignore or delete; refrain from making any recommendations; respond to the request
ms: Tiga pilihan: abaikan atau padam; elak memberi syor; balas permintaan

en: Personalise with the name; open with appreciation; convey the news politely and concisely; avoid explanations; don’t imply later review; close with positive wishes
ms: Peribadikan dengan nama; buka dengan penghargaan; sampaikan berita sopan dan ringkas; elak penjelasan; jangan tersirat semakan kemudian; tutup dengan harapan baik

en: Document performance problems; evaluate all employees consistently; write calmly and objectively; focus on opportunities for improvement; keep job descriptions up to date
ms: Dokumenkan masalah prestasi; nilai semua pekerja konsisten; tulis tenang dan objektif; fokus peluang penambahbaikan; kemas kini deskripsi kerja

en: Present reasons clearly and neutrally; follow company policy and laws; avoid personal attacks; have a colleague review the letter; deliver in person
ms: Reka sebab jelas dan neutral; ikut dasar dan undang-undang; elak serangan peribadi; rakan semak surat; sampaikan secara peribadi

q.en: Five goals of negative communication?

a.en: Convey bad news, gain acceptance, maintain goodwill, maintain good image, reduce future correspondence.
a.ms: Sampaikan berita buruk, dapat penerimaan, kekal muhibah, kekal imej, kurang surat-menyurat susulan.

q.en: Planning a negative message: four tasks?

a.en: Consider audience and purpose, select medium, define main idea, choose approach.
a.ms: Pertimbang audiens dan tujuan, pilih medium, tentukan idea utama, pilih pendekatan.

q.en: Completing a negative message: four tasks?

a.en: Revise, produce professional documents, proofread, deliver promptly.
a.ms: Semak, hasilkan dokumen profesional, semak bukti, hantar segera.

q.en: How does the direct approach open?

a.en: With a clear statement of the bad news in a calm, professional tone.
a.ms: Dengan pernyataan jelas berita buruk, nada tenang dan profesional.

q.en: Three rules for apologising?

a.en: Right person, only if sincere, quickly.
a.ms: Orang betul, hanya jika ikhlas, cepat.

q.en: How to close a direct negative message?

a.en: Consider alternatives, include positive statements, communicate how future mistakes will be avoided.
a.ms: Pertimbang alternatif, pernyataan positif, nyatakan cara elak kesilapan.

q.en: What is a buffer?

a.en: An opening that is neutral, finds common ground, shows appreciation or understanding, relevant and sincere.
a.ms: Pembukaan neutral, titik persamaan, penghargaan atau kefahaman, relevan dan ikhlas.

q.en: Three ways to handle bad news carefully?

a.en: De-emphasise it, use a conditional statement, tell what you did rather than what you didn’t.
a.ms: Kurangkan penekanan, pernyataan bersyarat, nyatakan apa dibuat bukan yang tidak dibuat.

q.en: Five ways to close an indirect negative message?
q.ms: Lima cara menutup mesej negatif tidak terus?

a.en: Positive angle, avoid uncertain conclusion, manage future correspondence, express optimism, be sincere.
a.ms: Sudut positif, elak kesimpulan tidak pasti, urus surat-menyurat, optimisme, ikhlas.

q.en: Four challenges of sending/receiving negative messages?

a.en: Legal compliance, impact on recipient, managing emotions, timing.
a.ms: Pematuhan undang-undang, kesan kepada penerima, urus emosi, masa.

q.en: Whistleblower support elements?

a.en: Open communication, internal and external reporting, timely communication, active listening, protection.
a.ms: Komunikasi terbuka, pelaporan dalaman dan luaran, tepat masa, mendengar aktif, perlindungan.

q.en: Four steps for routine negative announcements?

a.en: Open with a buffer, advance reasoning, announce the change, close positively.
a.ms: Buka dengan buffer, kemukakan alasan, umum perubahan, tutup positif.

q.en: Three factors in rejecting proposals?

a.en: Solicited or unsolicited; internal or external; relationship with the sender.
a.ms: Diminta atau tidak; dalaman atau luaran; hubungan dengan penghantar.

q.en: Three goals for bad news about transactions?

a.en: Modify customer expectations, explain how you will resolve, repair relationship.
a.ms: Ubah jangkaan pelanggan, terangkan penyelesaian, pulihkan hubungan.

q.en: DOs and DON’Ts when refusing claims?
q.ms: BUAT dan JANGAN semasa menolak tuntutan?

a.en: DO: accurate info, consult legal advisers, honesty, good future relationship. DON’T: abusive language, anger/malice, negative tone, accusations.
a.ms: BUAT: maklumat tepat, penasihat undang-undang, jujur, hubungan masa depan. JANGAN: bahasa kesat, marah, nada negatif, tuduhan.

q.en: Six points for normal negative organisational news?
q.ms: Enam poin berita organisasi negatif biasa?

a.en: Match approach, needs of each group, time to react, plan response, positive angles, expert advice.
a.ms: Padan pendekatan, keperluan kumpulan, masa bertindak balas, rancang respons, sudut positif, nasihat pakar.

q.en: Four steps for responding to online rumours?
q.ms: Empat langkah membalas khabar angin dalam talian?

a.en: Engage early and often, monitor, evaluate, respond appropriately.
a.ms: Libat awal dan kerap, pantau, nilai, balas sesuai.

q.en: Crisis management plan contents?

a.en: Operational procedures, communication tasks and responsibilities, list of news and social media outlets.
a.ms: Prosedur operasi, tugas dan tanggungjawab komunikasi, senarai saluran berita dan media sosial.

q.en: Rejecting job applications: tips?

a.en: Personalise, open with appreciation, polite concise news, avoid explanations, don’t imply later review, positive wishes.
a.ms: Peribadikan, buka penghargaan, berita sopan ringkas, elak penjelasan, jangan tersirat semakan, harapan baik.

q.en: Negative performance review tips?

a.en: Document problems, evaluate consistently, calm objective voice, focus on improvement, update job descriptions.
a.ms: Dokumen masalah, nilai konsisten, suara tenang objektif, fokus penambahbaikan, kemas kini deskripsi kerja.

q.en: Terminating employment tips?

a.en: Clear neutral reasons, follow policy and law, no personal attacks, colleague review, deliver in person.
a.ms: Sebab jelas neutral, ikut dasar dan undang-undang, tiada serangan, rakan semak, sampaikan peribadi.
